articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses what were previously separate models into a single end-to-end system. Benchmarks show substantial gains on ARC-AGI-2 and GPQA Diamond, with the model demonstrating markedly better calibration and reduced hallucination rates compared to GPT-4o.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New Standard for Agentic Code Generation
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a 2M-token context window and deeply integrated tool-use capabilities, scoring at the top of the SWE-Bench Verified leaderboard. The model can autonomously navigate complex multi-file codebases, write and execute tests, and iterate on failures, pushing the frontier of AI-driven software engineering workflows.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Warehouse Shift with Figure 03 Humanoids
articles.summary: Figure announced that a team of its Figure 03 humanoid robots completed an uninterrupted 8-hour warehouse logistics shift at a BMW facility with no human teleoperation. The robots handled bin picking, palletizing, and inter-station transport using on-board vision-language models for real-time task planning, marking a milestone for general-purpose humanoid deployment in industrial settings.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Limited Production, Promises Sub-$25K Price Point
articles.summary: Tesla began limited production of its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot at its Texas Gigafactory, with Elon Musk reiterating a target retail price below $25,000. The updated hardware features 28 degrees of freedom in the hands, improved actuator density, and an on-device inference stack running a distilled version of Tesla's FSD neural network for navigation and manipulation.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's 'Artifacts Workspace' — a Full In-Context IDE for Enterprise
articles.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's Artifacts feature into a full collaborative workspace supporting multi-file projects, persistent state, version control integration, and real-time co-editing between AI and human engineers. Enterprise customers report 30-40% reductions in prototyping cycle times, with the system able to maintain coherent architectural context across sessions.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) transistor process, several months ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers approximately 20% performance gains and 30% power reduction versus N2, with leading AI chip customers including NVIDIA and Apple among the first to tape out designs targeting late 2026 products.

articles.title: Microsoft and Atom Computing Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Quantum Operations at 1,200 Logical Qubits
articles.summary: Microsoft, partnering with Atom Computing, demonstrated reliable fault-tolerant quantum error correction across 1,200 logical qubits on their neutral-atom platform, a significant scale-up from previous demonstrations. The milestone brings practical quantum advantage for certain optimization and materials-simulation workloads closer to reality, with Azure Quantum offering cloud access to the system.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth Open-Weight Model with Mixture-of-Experts at 2T Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the open weights for Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that rivals proprietary frontier systems on reasoning and multilingual benchmarks. The release includes LoRA-compatible fine-tuning recipes and optimized inference kernels for multi-node deployments, further intensifying the open-source AI ecosystem's competitiveness with closed providers.
